name: Storm-0940
akas: China-state aligned (Microsoft); UNC7228 (GTIG's identifier for the same activity)
brief: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports a China-state-aligned actor using ARTEX, an open-source multi-agent penetration-testing framework that can drive any AI model, to automate reconnaissance, password spraying and OAuth-app abuse at machine speed: a spray against 327 accounts at 8 organizations (10–14 Oct 2026), then compromise of a ConnectWise multi-tenant app (Cloud Backup) followed by ARTEX-driven sign-in attempts against 2,250+ tenants, with privileged cloud access in under three hours in some intrusions. Hundreds of organizations across aerospace/defense, automotive, chemicals, energy, financial services and government were targeted. *Analyst note: same tool as the CrowdStrike/Recorded Future ARTEX row but a distinct campaign (different victims, vector and attribution). Microsoft names no underlying model; attribution is Microsoft's own. Vendor source.* Microsoft
